headline: Base Lines Shift Across Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Warden holdings have advanced in two troubled sectors: Linn Mercy now lists two Warden bases, against none previously, while its eight Colonial bases remain and one base is unheld. Marban Hollow has moved from two Warden bases and three unheld to four Warden and one unheld, with its three Colonial bases unchanged. Weathered Expanse has swung the other way, from four Warden bases to three, while Colonial holdings rose from one to three; three bases now stand unheld. Mooring County, previously wholly Warden-held, now has one unheld base. The event ledgers remain busiest in Weathered, Marban and Linn; each recorded activity in the last two hours, as did Mooring County and Stlican Shelf. Nevish Line’s ownership tally is unchanged, but its ledger shows no event rows in the latest two hours after 23 in the preceding six-hour window. Rows can record both sides of a single base change. War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
